data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'najid', meaning 'to guide' or 'to help'. In Islamic tradition, Najida symbolizes the spiritual guide or helper sent by Allah to those in need. The name Najida carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najida usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
